payload.core_mechanism_summary: Post-order DFS maintains per-node DP array where index i gives max weight with nearest selected vertex at distance >= i. Merges child arrays with constraint that selected vertices must be >k apart, using suffix maxima for feasibility.
payload.rationale: The solution directly operates on the tree structure via recursive DFS, merging child DP arrays into a parent array. No 2D grid or explicit graph search is performed; it's a classic tree DP for distance constraints.
